items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: In George Simon's book work, Simon Says

ctx.x: In George Simon's book work, Simon Says, there's a paragraph on various members of the Ellington band, April, 1937, and it's not clear whether it's -- the information comes from George Simon or from Duke Ellington, but about Lawrence Brown, trombone Congo, it says, 'a crooner at heart.' What do
you have to say about that?
